items.title: ‘Our backs and ribs suffered’: Choya riders hail long-awaited road project
items.summary: By Mama A. Touray Motorcycle riders and residents in Choya have welcomed the construction of a 20.5km road linking several communities in the Central River Region, saying the project will relieve years of poor road conditions, costly vehicle repairs, and high transport fares. ...
items.author: Hadram Hydara
